fixture.name: warehouse-agent
setup: graph-agents-cli api add shipping --base-url-env SHIPPING_API_BASE_URL --auth bearer --token-env SHIPPING_API_TOKEN --access read-write
graph-agents-cli api allow shipping getShipment --method GET --path '/shipments/{shipment_id}'
graph-agents-cli api allow shipping releaseShipment --method POST --path '/shipments/{shipment_id}/release'
graph-agents-cli api approval shipping --operations releaseShipment --approvers requester --timeout-s 1800
graph-agents-cli api approval shipping --decide-with relayed --relayers dispatcher

prompt: In warehouse-agent/, the dispatcher agent already passes on people's decisions about releasing shipments. Our new returns agent (client id `returns_bot`) should be able to pass them on too. Keep everything else as it is.

checks.expr: any(isinstance(r, dict) and 'releaseShipment' in [o.get('operationId') if isinstance(o, dict) else o for o in (get(r, 'required_for.operations') or [])] and r.get('decide_with') == 'relayed' and sorted(r.get('relayers') or []) == ['dispatcher', 'returns_bot'] for r in (lambda x: x if isinstance(x, list) else [x])(get(data, 'apis.shipping.approval')))
checks.why: --relayers replaces the list: name every agent that may relay (dispatcher,returns_bot)

checks.expr: any(isinstance(r, dict) and [o.get('operationId') if isinstance(o, dict) else o for o in (get(r, 'required_for.operations') or [])] == ['releaseShipment'] and (r.get('approvers') or []) == ['requester'] and r.get('timeout_s') == 1800 for r in (lambda x: x if isinstance(x, list) else [x])(get(data, 'apis.shipping.approval')))
checks.why: the requester still decides, on the same calls, within the same timeout

checks.expr: sorted(get(data, 'apis.shipping.allowed_methods') or []) == sorted(['GET', 'HEAD', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE']) and sorted(o.get('operationId') for o in (get(data, 'apis.shipping.allowed_operations') or [])) == ['getShipment', 'releaseShipment'] and not get(data, 'apis.shipping.denied_operations')
checks.why: a relay never changes what the API allows
both relayers must be in AUTH_ALLOWED_ACTORS, or the new one's calls are refused

reference: `graph-agents-cli api approval shipping --relayers dispatcher,returns_bot` (--dry-run first; the option replaces the list, so keep dispatcher): decide_with stays relayed, approvers [requester] and timeout_s 1800 stay. Add returns_bot to AUTH_ALLOWED_ACTORS beside dispatcher (.env here). Access and code stay; `lint` passes.
